user.title: Add a TSUN Local device
user.description: Choose automatic network search or manual configuration.

manual.title: Manual configuration
manual.description: Enter the IP address and port. Home Assistant first tries to read the Monitor SN / Logger SN automatically from the logger's local status page. If it cannot be read, this form will ask you to enter it manually.

data.logger_sn: Monitor SN / Logger SN (Device serial number)

discover.title: Devices found
discover.description: Select an address found on the configured TCP port. Home Assistant first tries to read the Monitor SN / Logger SN automatically from the logger's local status page. If it cannot be read, this form will ask you to enter it manually.

data.logger_sn: Monitor SN / Logger SN (Device serial number)

discover_network.title: Network to scan
discover_network.description: No device was found on the networks detected by Home Assistant. Enter the micro-inverter IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation (for example 192.168.1.0/24). The scan is limited to 254 addresses.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or TCP port. The Monitor SN / Logger SN remains the permanent identity.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device
error.cannot_detect_logger_sn: Automatic detection failed. Enter the Monitor SN / Logger SN shown as Device serial number on the local status page or printed on the device label.
error.invalid_network: Enter a valid IPv4 subnet between /24 and /32
error.invalid_response: The device returned an invalid response
error.no_devices_found: No device accepting local connections was found on this subnet and port

abort.all_devices_configured: All detected micro-inverters are already configured
abort.no_devices_found: No device accepting local connections on port 8899 was found

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: Set normal polling, retry after a communication error, offline/night polling, and the number of consecutive failures required before the device goes offline.
